nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract, set to msg.sender in constructor and checked by onlyOwner.
Pending new owner address used by transferOwnership/acceptOwnership two-step handover.
Mapping of token holder balances mutated by transfer, transferFrom and constructor.
Nested mapping of owner->spender allowances mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Total token supply, set to 5000000000 in the constructor.
Owned.transferOwnership: onlyOwner function that sets newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership: requires msg.sender == newOwner and completes ownership transfer.
ERC20 transfer: debits msg.sender and credits the recipient using safe math.
onlyOwner batch transfer looping over dests/values arrays and calling transfer.
ERC20 approve: writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] without double-spend protection.
ERC20 transferFrom: debits from, decrements allowance of msg.sender and credits to.
approveAndCall: sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract.
onlyOwner rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 token address.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts; contract rejects ETH.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and balance/allowance keys.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to an attacker-controlled contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary contract.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply (arithmetic).
tokens amount parameter of transfer, approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
spender address parameter of approve and approveAndCall (and allowance).
to recipient address parameter of transfer and transferFrom.
from address parameter of transferFrom.
dests array parameter of transferMultiple.
values array parameter of transferMultiple.
data bytes parameter forwarded in approveAndCall.
_newOwner address parameter of transferOwnership.
tokenAddress parameter of transferAnyERC20Token.
tokenOwner address parameter of balanceOf and allowance.
Loop counter local variable i in transferMultiple.

edges.reason: acceptOwnership authorizes the ownership handover via require(msg.sender == newOwner).
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner which requires msg.sender == owner.
transferMultiple is guarded by onlyOwner, msg.sender must equal owner.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner, msg.sender must equal owner.
msg.sender is used as the key into balances when debiting tokens in transfer.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] for the caller's allowance.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.
balances mapping is read and written by transfer.
balances mapping is read and written by transferFrom.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
approve writes the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in the onlyOwner check.
newOwner is compared with msg.sender then promoted to owner in acceptOwnership.
_totalSupply is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction.
The unchecked subtraction result is returned by totalSupply.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the spender contract which can reenter before returning.
transferAnyERC20Token calls an arbitrary token contract whose transfer can reenter this contract.
transferMultiple calls the internal transfer function for each recipient.
tokens amount is subtracted from and added to balances in transfer.
tokens amount is written into the allowance in approve.
tokens amount is moved and deducted from the allowance in transferFrom.
tokens amount is stored and forwarded in approveAndCall.
spender keys the allowed mapping in approve.
spender is used as the allowance key and external call target in approveAndCall.
spender identity determines which allowance is spent in transferFrom.
to address receives the credited balance in transfer.
to address receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
from address is debited and its allowance keyed in transferFrom.
dests array supplies transfer recipients and bounds the loop in transferMultiple.
values array supplies the token amounts transferred in transferMultiple.
data bytes are forwarded to the spender contract in approveAndCall.
_newOwner is assigned to the newOwner state variable.
tokenAddress selects the external ERC20 contract to call in transferAnyERC20Token.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
loop index i iterates over dests and values in transferMultiple.

normalization_plan.reason: tokens is only meaningful as the amount argument consumed by transfer and its siblings.
spender is only used as the allowance key and call target inside approve.
to is only the recipient argument of transfer.
from is only the debited account argument of transferFrom.
dests is only the recipient array iterated by transferMultiple.
values is only the amount array paired with dests in transferMultiple.
data is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
_newOwner is only stored into newOwner inside transferOwnership.
tokenAddress is only used to select the external token contract in transferAnyERC20Token.
tokenOwner is only the lookup key for balanceOf.
local loop counter i exists only to drive the transferMultiple loop.
